library.title: Apply for a controlled medicine authorisation
library.intro: Apply for the special authorisation the law requires to import, export, make, supply or hold a controlled medicine. The authorisation is for an organisation, a product and a quantity, never for a named patient. Quantities are checked against the limits the nation sets under its controlled-substances law.
library.filled_by: A licensed organisation (a registered organisation) or someone acting for it.
library.authority: The medicines regulator the nation names under Who is responsible. Its slot is controlledSubstances, which ships empty: until the nation names it, the medicines regulator slot (medicinesRegulation) stands in, and while that is empty the health regulator slot (healthRegulation), as a provisional owner, shown as provisional, refused as the competent authority in production and never proof of legal competence; each power over a product type comes from the approved permit authority mapping; never a ministry by name.
library.intended: A controlled-medicine authorisation procedure of the authority the nation's controlled-substances law names, under an approved permit mapping: not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

nation_values.decision: How long a controlled-medicine authorisation is valid.
The quantities of each controlled substance the nation may authorise in a period (its estimates or limits under its controlled-substances law).

deviations.what: Authorises an organisation, a product and a quantity, never a named patient; supply to a person is a dispensing record, which the approved scope excludes
deviations.why: No patient or dispensing record on the platform.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Health: no patient or clinical field anywhere; owner's direction 2026-10-21 §1 (dispensing records excluded)

deviations.what: The controlled-substances authority may be another institution than the medicines regulator; the form names the controlled-substances slot (controlledSubstances), which ships empty: until the nation names it, the medicines regulator slot stands in, then the health regulator slot, as a provisional owner, never proof of legal competence
deviations.why: Who holds the power is the nation's law, recorded in the deployment profile and the permit authority registry.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: authorityFor(); never assume a ministry by name

deviations.what: Patient consent, emergency clinical access and a shared patient reference do not arise: the form carries no patient, clinical, treatment, diagnosis or individual health field
deviations.why: Allowed scope only: records of products, of organisations (holders, manufacturers, importers) and of the regulator's decisions.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Health: no patient or clinical field anywhere, no national patient record; owner's direction 2026-10-21 §1

deviations.what: The form names the medicines-regulator slot (medicinesRegulation), which ships empty: until the nation names it, the health regulator slot (healthRegulation, "Health facility regulation") stands in as a provisional owner (lib/nation/deployment.ts provisionalOwner()), never proof of legal competence; each power over a product type comes from the approved permit authority mapping
deviations.why: Who is responsible comes only from the deployment profile and the permit authority registry; the platform never names a ministry or assumes an institution (integration register 20.9).
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: authorityFor(), lib/permits/authority.ts; never assume a ministry by name

deviations.what: The regulated product record (Part 6 §5.2) is not on the platform yet: a reference to an authorised product is recorded as given and its check recorded as not performed, a product's status is shown nowhere until the regulator's product register exists, and it is never inferred from an import, inventory or procurement record
deviations.why: Each status must come from the competent regulator's authoritative record; a register is built with its procedures, not stood in for by a form.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Integration register (20.5 registers a form references that are not on the platform; 20.9); Part 6 §5.2

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
